name: Activity Feed — Mine / Everyone Toggle
description: The activity feed has two views: 'Mine' (friends-only) and 'Everyone' (global site activity), selectable via a toggle at the top of /feed.php. Both views support Chronological and Grouped sort modes.
evidence_quote: Feed 👥 MINE 🌐 EVERYONE 🕓 CHRONOLOGICAL ⊞ GROUPED

name: Activity Feed — Content Filter (Everything vs Shorter Selection)
description: Users can configure feed content scope via 'Everything' (all activity types) or 'Shorter selection' (filtered subset), and also mute specific networks from appearing in the feed.
evidence_quote: ⚙️ SELECTION … Networks included in your feed … Shorter selection … ✔ Everything

name: Activity Feed — Supported Item Types (Everyone view)
description: The Everyone feed surfaces: status messages, diary entries, pictures (with caption), profile updates, network discussion posts, calendar additions, and interview publications — all interleaved chronologically or grouped by type.
evidence_quote: Diary entry … Regler för saknad … has updated their profile page … started a new discussion in … has changed profile picture … added to the calendar …

name: Status Message Composer
description: A persistent status-message input field is exposed inside the top navigation bar's personal menu on every page; messages are capped at 190 characters and can be cleared with a dedicated button.
evidence_quote: input … maxlength="190" … placeholder="What´s on your mind?" … ❌️ Clear

name: VIP — Profile Cover Picture
description: Adding a cover (header) image to one's profile page is locked behind VIP membership; a 'Requires VIP membership' label is shown inline in the Presentation settings.
evidence_quote: Cover picture   (Requires VIP membership)

name: VIP — Picture Before Presentation Text
description: Inserting a picture above the profile presentation text is gated behind VIP; a 'This function is only available to VIP members' notice is shown in-form.
evidence_quote: Picture before presentation text — This function is only available to VIP members

name: VIP — Profile Color & Background Customization
description: Free members see the color and background customization controls in Presentation settings but the cover picture requiring VIP is adjacent; the color controls (text color, background, headline/accent, link color) appear available to all plans.
evidence_quote: Colors and background — Text color: Default Custom — Background color: Default Custom — Headline/accent color: Default Custom — Link color: Default Custom

name: VIP — Email Alerts for New Messages and Activity
description: Email notifications for messages, feedback, and other activity while logged out require VIP membership; the setting is visible but locked for free accounts.
evidence_quote: E-mail alerts — You need VIP membership to use this function.

name: VIP — Calendar and Birthday Reminders
description: Reminder notifications for events and friends' birthdays are gated behind VIP membership.
evidence_quote: Reminders — You can receive reminders for events, friends birthdays and other happenings. — You need VIP membership to use this function.

name: VIP — Sound Alerts
description: Real-time in-browser sound notifications for new messages and activity are a VIP-only feature.
evidence_quote: Sound — Sound alerts for new messages, feedback and material. You need VIP membership to use this function.

name: VIP — Visitor Log (enhanced)
description: Free members see a visitor log page but visitor identities are hidden (shown as '?????'); VIP members can see who visited, how many more visitors are listed, and which contact criteria visitors match.
evidence_quote: VIP members can easily see which of your requirements visitors matches. VIP members can also see many more visitors than non-VIP members.

name: VIP — Messaging Quota and Folder Labels
description: Free accounts receive 110 kB of message inbox storage; VIP members get 'thousands of messages' of space. Both free and VIP can create custom labels and sort/filter conversations; picture attachments in messages are described as a VIP benefit.
evidence_quote: Quota: 110 kB. Total used: 0 kB (0%). Remaining: 110 kB.

name: Messaging — Conversation Labels, Sort, and Download
description: Inbox supports custom conversation labels ('Create new label'), sort by newest-first or unread-first, bulk select/delete, default-view preference (All vs Uncategorized), and a full-conversation download.
evidence_quote: ➕ Create new label … ✔ Sorting: Newest first … Sorting: Unread first … ☑️ Select messages (show checkboxes) … ⤓ Download a copy of the messages

name: Messaging — Spam / Contact Filter Settings
description: A dedicated settings page controls who can send the user messages (spam/filter settings), accessible from the inbox via '⚙️ Spam settings / who can send me messages'.
evidence_quote: ⚙️ Spam settings / who can send me messages — href: /kontakt.php?a=e

name: Profile Editor — Tabs and Sections
description: Own profile has 7 navigable tabs: Profile (presentation text, interests, personality traits, contact preferences), Wall (guestbook), Sexuality & identity, Diary/Texts, Interview, Friends, Pictures. Editing is accessible via inline edit icons on the profile tab.
evidence_quote: Profile Wall Sexuality & identity Diary/Texts Interview Friends Pictures More…

name: Sexuality & Identity Taxonomy
description: Profile sexuality section covers: gender identity (17+ options including non-binary, gender fluid, demigirl/guy), intersex, gender expression (crossdressing, drag), attraction/orientation, relationship forms (mono/poly/RA/ambi), D/s roles, leather culture identities, appearance-based identities, preferred BDSM practices, garment/material preferences, bodily practices, and preferred social contexts — all selectable as structured tags.
evidence_quote: Gender fluid Genderqueer … Dominant Submissive Sadist Masochist Switch … Bondage Shibari … Polyamorous Relationship anarchist … Play parties Munches Cuddle puddles Swinging

name: Contact Intent Selectors
description: Members declare which types of contact they are open to from a structured list: General contact, Friendship, Club company, Social kink, Guidance, Flirt, Sex chat, Sexual practices, Relationship, Other. These are browsable/filterable fields used in member discovery.
evidence_quote: Contact types: General contact … Friendship … Club company … Social kink … Guidance … Flirt … Sex chat … Sexual practices … Relationship … Other

name: Profile Completeness Gate on Member Browsing
description: Accessing the advanced member search (browse by contact criteria) and viewing random member profiles is blocked for accounts without a profile picture, personal information, and a substantial bio; the gate shows a specific list of required items.
evidence_quote: Access denied — You need to have a substantial profile of your own in order to use this function. Add a picture of yourself, make sure you have supplied personal information and a substantial text.

name: Matches / Seems Interesting — Mutual-Interest Matching
description: Members can flag others as 'Seems nice / interesting'; mutual flags create a 'Match'. The Matches & Suggestions page lists mutual matches and shows members who flagged you one-directionally. Building matches requires an attractive, complete profile.
evidence_quote: Matches … When you stumble upon someone interesting, click 'Seems nice / interesting'. The more you express interest in that way, the greater the chance to achieve a match.

name: Networks (Groups) — Structure and Membership
description: Networks are categorized groups (1400+ total across sexuality, interests, regional, etc.); each network has Overview, Discussions, Documents, Events, and Members tabs. A non-member can read the overview and discussions but must 'Sign up' to post. Network pages display owner/admin list, member count, primary language, and pinned topics.
evidence_quote: You are not a member. Sign up … Overview Discussions Documents Events Members … Started 22 mar 2014. The network has 8055 members … PINNED TOPICS

name: Calendar — Event Creation Form
description: Authenticated users can create events with: title, visibility (public/members-only/private), hide-participants toggle, single or multi-day date/time, location (country+region+city or online), cover image, description (multilingual), acceptance level, tags, access code, website/email, entry requirements (membership, dresscode, pre-registration, other), gender restrictions (individual gender checkboxes), comment settings.
evidence_quote: Headline … Visibility: Public / Active members / Private … Hide participants list … Date/Time … Online event … Membership required … Dresscode … Application required … This event welcomes all genders / Only specific genders

name: Calendar — RSVP Affordances on Event Detail
description: Event detail page shows 'Attending' and 'Interested' RSVP buttons, participant list, comment section with notification preferences (notify on host post / all posts / friends posts / none), a Propagate/share button, and a post-event Review tab.
evidence_quote: ✔ ATTENDING INTERESTED … Participants … + INVITE PARTICIPANTS … 1 attending … Notify when the host posts / Notify when anyone posts … 📣 PROPAGATE … Reviews: You can review this event from 14 on the date it occurs.

name: VIP Pricing — Tiers and Payment Methods
description: VIP is the single paid tier, sold in 2-month (80 SEK / ~€8), 6-month (190 SEK / ~€19), and 1-year (320 SEK / ~€32) bundles. Payments accepted: Swish (Swedish), Visa/Mastercard via crypto app, Bitcoin, Ethereum, USD Coin, other crypto, Swedish bank transfer, IBAN. Giftable to other members.
evidence_quote: VIP membership 2 months (80 SEK / ~€8) … 6 months (190 SEK / ~€19) … 1 year (320 SEK / ~€32) … from 0:87 SEK (~€0:09) / day … Swish … Bitcoin … Ethereum … IBAN

name: VIP — Picture Upload Quota
description: Free accounts receive 4000 kB of picture storage. VIP members can upload hundreds of pictures (per VIP page copy); the free quota of 4000 kB was directly observed on the authenticated pictures page.
evidence_quote: Quota: 4000 kB

name: New Material Aggregator Feed
description: '/news.php' presents a multi-section aggregated 'new material' stream covering: Library (stories/articles), Discussions (by network), Diaries, Calendar events, Interviews, Market listings, Dictionary updates, Photo albums, and Status messages — all in one scrollable view with Mine/Everyone toggle and Grouped/Chronological sort.
evidence_quote: New material 👥 MINE 🌐 EVERYONE ⊞ GROUPED 🕓 CHRONOLOGICAL — Library … Discussions … Diaries … Calendar … Interview … Market … Dictionary … Album … Status messages
